notes: Only two Bulbapedia bulk pages were requested; both returned HTTP 200 without access workarounds.
The height list groups cards under explicit metric-height labels; the weight list prints each metric weight in its individual card.
Dex IDs were read from four-digit artwork filenames and independently matched to all 251 species names in existing game metadata.
Cards with form labels were excluded, covering Mega, regional, Gigantamax, Partner, and Totem-like forms when listed.
No imperial-unit conversion was used: the metric values printed by Bulbapedia were extracted directly.
sourceUrl links the species page referenced in both source cards; per-dimension bulk-list sources are retained in rowEvidence.
Gastly has a physical Pokédex weight of 0.1 kg; no included weight was changed to zero.
